Effective rolls equal the sum of useful RV weighted by relevance (default 1) / 100: one maximum-value substat roll is one unit. The lower bound of rounding ambiguity is used. Talent levels exclude constellation bonuses. Constellations, signature weapons and purchased refinements are not required.
